output.reason: [ev-685e81f5b751] only says `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` was removed from the modern XR schema. It does not say what happens to environments that read or depend on that field. The field is a status field written by the controller, not an operator-configured value, so "setting-ignored" (configured values stop being honoured) is not supported. The surrounding release-notes section has no upgrade-guide text about the removal. To decide the consequence, we need the PR #6655 description or an upgrade-guide passage that says whether consumers of this status field break, or that the change is limited to modern XRs and has no operator impact.
